![]({{Z00}})

The **Season System** that will keep competition alive all year long is starting in SexyKO.

Each season opens with boosted **EXP • DROP • COIN** rates so new players can catch up with the main server faster.

When the season ends, players are moved to the **main SexyKO server** together with their progress.

![]({{Z01}})

![]({{Z05}})

## 🔁 03 · HOW DOES A SEASON WORK?

![]({{Z02}})

- **01 — SEASON OPENING:** Each new season opens on Friday at 22:00.
- **02 — ACCELERATED PROGRESS:** EXP, DROP and COIN rates are boosted on season servers.
- **03 — STEPPED RATES:** The first season starts at 100%. In later seasons the rates rise step by step up to 800%.
- **04 — TOURNAMENT SIGN-UP:** Tournament sign-ups open at 12:00 on the Monday after the season starts.
- **05 — MERGE WITH THE MAIN SERVER:** When the season ends, players are moved to the main SexyKO server together with their progress.

---

## 📈 04 · STEPPED RATES

![]({{Z03}})

The first season starts at **100%**; every season **EXP · DROP · COIN** go up one step together: S01 100% → S02 200% → S03 300% → S04 400% → S05 500% → S06 600% → S07 700% → S08 800%.

---

## 🏆 05 · TOURNAMENT SYSTEM

![]({{Z04}})

- 📌 **Sign-up Starts:** Monday • 12:00
- 📌 **Tournament Announcement:** Merge Day
- 📌 **Matchups:** Will be announced after the merge.

The season opens on Friday. Tournament sign-ups start on Monday at 12:00. When the season closes — on merge day — the tournament is announced.

💡 Rewards and details of the tournament system will be announced separately.

- Faster progress for new players.

- One server at the end of every season.
